title: The lost book
starting_code: # Where is the book? Find it, bring it, and give it to Eldra.
hints: Keep what `find_nearest` gives back under a name, and print where it lies.
Pick the book up on its tile, then walk back until you stand right beside Eldra.
In the brackets of `wizard.give` goes the book itself: the name you kept it under.
intro: Oh, someone new! I lost my book, oh, so long ago. Could you find it, and bring it to me?
outro: My book! After all these years. Thank you, {wizard}.
